name: ProbabilityTheory.cgf
type: {Ω : Type u} → {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} → (Ω → ℝ) → MeasureTheory.Measure Ω → ℝ → ℝ
provides: Scalar cumulant-generating function defined as the real logarithm of the scalar MGF; a vector argument can be encoded through its scalar inner product with the random vector, but genuine finite expectation and differentiability require separate assumptions.
type_review: Inspected cgf and mgf bodies with their surrounding parameters, integral and real-log totalization, and the interior-integrableExpSet hypotheses of the analytic CGF results; manually expanded type, not compiled.
